login.title: Chanɛl Patna Lɔgin
login.welcome: Welkam bak! Sayn in fɔ manej yu lida dɛn.
login.heroTitle: Grow yu rial-estate biznɛs wit ɛvri lida we yu de briŋ
login.heroIntro: Wan pɔtal fɔ rɛjista kɔstɔma dɛn wit bilda dɛn, kip di kredit fɔ yu lida dɛn ɛn fala dɛn fɔ buk.

register.title: Rɛjista lida dɛn insay sɛkɔn
register.text: Sɔbmit yu kɔstɔma ɛn di prɔjek we dɛn intres pan.

protect.title: Dupliket protɛkshɔn
protect.text: Yu lid de de na yu yon fɔ di tɛm we yu de protɛkt yu, so nɔbɔdi nɔ go ebul fɔ klem di sem kɔstɔma.

track.title: Trak ɛvri stej
track.text: Si ɛni lida in stetɔs ɛn ful istri, frɔm di fɔs kɔntakt to di bukin.

handover.title: Krɛdit we yu de buk
handover.text: We kɔstɔma buk, dɛn kin gi di lid to di bilda wit yu we dɛn rayt as di sɔs patna.

login.secure: Sikyu sayn-in - yu kɔstɔma dɛn ditil dɛn de prayvet
login.builderPrompt: Yu na pɔsin we de bil?
login.builderLink: Sayn in to di bilda pɔtal

signup.title: Chanɛl Patna Rɛjista
signup.intro: Krio yu akɔn fɔ bigin fɔ rɛjista ɛn manej yu yon lida dɛn.
signup.accountDetails: Di Ditiɛl dɛn bɔt di Akɔn
signup.organisationDetails: Di Ditiɛl dɛn bɔt di Ɔganayzeshɔn
